lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are visible on the posterior flank, arranged in three distinct vertical columns containing 2 to 4 spots each, localized anterior to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows on the posterior flank to form a non-uniform grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the posterior flank, characterized by high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower edges, converging towards the tail base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The superior margin of the upper caudal lobe exhibits a series of irregular notches and a prominent semi-circular indentation mid-length.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 8 high-luminance spots is localized on the central surface of the lower caudal lobe, distinct from the primary flank pattern.
